system.description:
When your Strike is a Critical Hit, roll a Luck Check against the enemy's CR. On a success deal triple damage instead of double; on a Full House deal quadruple damage.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.59
system.summary: When your Strike is a Critical Hit, roll a Luck Check against the enemy's CR. On a success deal triple damage instead of double; on a Full House deal quadruple damage.

automation.label: After one of your Strikes is a Critical Hit; CR = that enemy's CR
automation.onSuccess: Triple damage instead of double (quadruple on a Full House).

automation.note: On a success, the Director deals the difference by hand so the Strike totals triple its base damage (quadruple on a Full House). The extra depends on the weapon, so it isn't applied automatically.
